d:
During our Bihar election coverage, Khabargaon travelled to Chief Minister Nitish Kumar’s village Kalyan Bigha in Harnaut assembly constituency.
We spoke to the villagers who have seen Nitish Kumar from a distance and also to those who have seen him from his childhood.
While the villagers support Kumar, they also have a few demands from him. What are those and how does the village look? Watch in this video.
Report: Satyam Tiwari
Camera: Abhishek
Video Editor: Akash Verma
